page.overview:
Who is Drunneq Bronzegrip?

Drunneq Bronzegrip was a master smith and a member of House Bronzegrip, one of the five ruling Houses of Kraghammer. At some point, he became fed up with what he regarded as "smoke-brained tavern tales" regarding rare, pre-refined metals left in the remains of deceased cinderslag elementals. He once explained that anyone thinking of seeking out a cinderslag elemental would only get themselves killed.

So far, Drunneq Bronzegrip has not appeared or been mentioned onstream.
